theorems.name: Submission.mcm_annulus_integration_by_parts
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (w : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (a e F F' : ℝ → ℝ) (σ ρ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) → IntegrableOn w (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ → IntegrableOn e (Ioc σ ρ) → (∀ s t : ℝ, σ ≤ s → s ≤ t → t ≤ ρ → a t - a s = ∫ x in closedBall ξ t \ closedBall ξ s, w x ∂μ + ∫ τ in Ioc s t, e τ) → IntegrableOn F' (Ioc σ ρ) → (∀ t ∈ Icc σ ρ, F t = F σ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ t, F' τ) → IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ F ‖x - ξ‖ * w x) (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ ∧ F ρ * a ρ - F σ * a σ = ∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ, F ‖x - ξ‖ * w x ∂μ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, (F τ * e τ + F' τ * a τ)
